_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.2 (the real file is narrative-seed's).

interact.description: The player engages with what is there.
interact.negative: Not a fight and not a trade; nothing is spent.

leave.description: The player walks away; a chain may continue later.
leave.negative: Not a failure, not a penalty; every storylet has exactly one.

use.description: A supply the party carries is spent.
use.negative: Not bring: a supply is consumed, a party member is not.

offer.description: A cost the runtime prices against a stock.
offer.negative: Not a bargain kind; the price is never written in the seed.

fight.description: A battle through the existing encounter builder.
fight.negative: Not threaten; a fight is the battle itself.

bring.description: A party member with the right element opens the choice.
bring.negative: Not use; nothing is spent, a party member qualifies.

persuade.description: A contest, won by a difference or the shipped flat coin.
persuade.negative: Not an offer; nothing is paid.

threaten.description: The same contest, framed as a threat.
threaten.negative: Not a fight; no battle starts from the threat itself.
